title: RepoPact Repository Orientation Graph capability declaration
description: Explicit, committed capability declaration for the durable Repository Orientation Graph (WI063, Decision 0051). Absence of this file is not an error at any schema version -- a repository with no declaration and no rog/ directory remains a fully valid, graph-disabled RepoPact repository; a repository with no declaration and an existing rog/ directory remains a fully valid, legacy-enabled repository. This record is read directly by the graph subsystem and is never represented as a graph node.
